candidates.description: This vector represents numerical values, likely measurements, quantities, or identifiers.
This vector activates on Roman numerals representing numbers.
These tokens represent numerical values that typically correspond to measurements, quantities, or round counts.
This vector represents a sequence of continuous integer numbers.
This vector is related to sequential numbers, specifically integers centered around the high 180s.
This vector represents French names, titles, and name-ending suffixes associated with French royalty and culture.

This vector represents the lowercase and uppercase French letter 'é' (often accented with an acute accent), both in isolation and as a common prefix or component within various French words and syllables.
This vector represents traditional European male given names.

This feature vector activates strongly on proper nouns, titles, and lexical roots starting with capitalized or accented Latin-alphabet strings, particularly around artistic, geographic, or linguistic terms.
This vector is related to common French and English given names and name-like name fragments.
